evidenceIndex.claim: Defines authority precedence for repository truth.
evidenceIndex.result: The package is derived support and cannot override canonical code, contracts or product truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines repository execution, scope and evidence discipline.
evidenceIndex.result: Control Panel scope must follow proven dependencies and latest-head evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines engineering, authorization, scope, data and verification rules.
evidenceIndex.result: Operator mutations require server-side authorization, trusted scope, durable readback and verification.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines diagnosis-package-only workflow and Control Panel special checks.
evidenceIndex.result: This task must create a complete implementation package without modifying runtime/product files.
The file is empty on the pinned head, so no architectural assertion can rely on it.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current route-section inventory on the pinned head.
evidenceIndex.result: DSH exposes administration, analytics, catalogs, dashboard, hr, login, marketing, operations, partners, platform and support; WLT exposes finance.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory presence does not prove behavioral correctness.

evidenceIndex.result: Control Panel access and navigation are cross-cutting and cannot be diagnosed page-by-page only.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove runtime session behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows Control Panel API/BFF and server-side boundary.
evidenceIndex.result: Operator pages have server/BFF dependencies that must be included with route/object authorization and trusted scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static inventory does not prove endpoint correctness.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows sovereign/shared DSH Control Panel modules.
evidenceIndex.result: The service layer includes section modules plus non-navigation modules such as carts, finance and maps, so navigation alone is incomplete coverage.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static inventory does not prove backend/database behavior.

evidenceIndex.result: WLT has shared frontend composition rather than a separate control-panel root; finance UI must reuse WLT-owned shared truth instead of creating parallel financial state.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static structure does not prove ledger correctness.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines derived Control Panel section coverage and manual control scenarios.
evidenceIndex.result: Registry covers mandatory UI states, authorization/scope/search/bulk/audit/session/readback classes and maps Control Panel sections to journeys.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Derived support is a completeness aid, not canonical product truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Provides derived journey discovery across DSH/WLT and surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: Control Panel writes/readbacks participate in multi-surface journeys and must be checked through downstream consequences.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows navigation source and runtime use.
evidenceIndex.result: Navigation is a presentation index, while hidden/detail routes and service modules require separate inventory.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Navigation does not enumerate all dependencies.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows DSH backend and PostgreSQL ownership boundary.
evidenceIndex.result: Operational Control Panel mutations/readbacks ultimately require DSH owner, contract and database verification where DSH owns truth.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Broad path evidence; each implementation slice still needs symbol-level tracing.

evidenceIndex.result: Finance, settlements, wallets, commissions and COD must remain WLT-owned with DSH/control-panel acting as consumers or governed bridges.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Broad path evidence; each financial mutation still needs protected verification.

evidenceIndex.result: Client, Partner, Captain and Field surfaces consume consequences of Control Panel state in their relevant journeys and therefore require compatibility/readback checks only where linked.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not make unrelated mobile-only features in scope.

entries.name: bthwani2-boop/bthwani-suite-next
entries.summary: Repository is the bounded source; execution is restricted to Control Panel and proven direct dependencies.

entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Primary surface; every current Control Panel section and its shared/server dependencies are in scope.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Included only where operator changes affect customer-visible catalog, order/support or financial readback.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Included only for Partner/Store/catalog/order/finance consequences of operator actions.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Included only for dispatch/custody/workforce/finance consequences controlled or read by Control Panel.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Included only for onboarding/workforce/financial-readiness consequences linked to Control Panel.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Administration is in scope including roles, actors, policies, audit and governed rollback paths.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Analytics and KPI operator readback are in scope.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Catalog governance, approval and detail routes are in scope.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Dashboard operational and health readback is in scope.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: HR/workforce operator workflows are in scope.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Operator login and session behavior are in scope.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Marketing visibility, promotions and governed publication are in scope.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Operations including order/dispatch intervention and hidden/detail flows are in scope.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Partner/Store lifecycle, nested detail and approval flows are in scope.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Platform configuration/serviceability controls are in scope.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Support, incident and rescue workflows are in scope.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: WLT finance route and all directly backing WLT financial flows are in scope.

entries.name: shell-navigation-session
entries.summary: Shell, navigation, session restoration and access gates apply across all sections.

entries.name: control-panel-api
entries.summary: Control Panel BFF/API handlers are in scope because UI authorization and mutation safety depend on them.

entries.name: control-panel-server
entries.summary: Server-side adapters/session/trusted-context code is in scope.

entries.name: dsh-control-panel
entries.summary: All DSH Control Panel shared modules are in scope, not only navigation-linked pages.

entries.name: carts
entries.summary: Cart diagnostics are a Control Panel module and must not be lost because they are not a top-level route section.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: DSH-facing finance bridge/readback is included while WLT remains monetary owner.

entries.name: maps
entries.summary: Map-assisted operator workflows are included as Control Panel operational dependencies.

entries.name: wlt-shared
entries.summary: WLT shared frontend is the existing financial presentation source used by Control Panel; no parallel control-panel WLT tree should be invented.

entries.name: dsh-backend-database
entries.summary: DSH-owned operator mutations/readbacks require backend, contract and PostgreSQL verification.

entries.name: wlt-backend-database
entries.summary: WLT-owned financial mutations/readbacks require ledger, authorization, idempotency and database verification.

entries.name: journey-registry
entries.summary: Used as a discovery completeness index for Control Panel-linked journeys, never as canonical product truth.

entries.name: control-panel-section-registry
entries.summary: Used to enforce section/state/control/manual-scenario completeness for every Control Panel area.

entries.name: direct-mobile-readbacks
entries.summary: Only direct consumers of Control Panel-controlled state are in scope; unrelated mobile-only behavior is excluded.

entries.name: unrelated-product-areas
entries.path: repository paths with no proven Control Panel dependency
entries.summary: Anything without a proven Control Panel section, operation, data-owner or readback dependency is excluded.
entries.exclusionReason: No pinned-head evidence connects this area to a Control Panel section, operator workflow, canonical owner or required downstream readback.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen immediately if code, contract, route, database, registry or runtime evidence proves a direct Control Panel dependency.
